d: In this video, we break down the real story behind tariffs and how they became powerful tools in global trade. Starting from the barter system, we explain how trade worked before tariffs existed and how trade taxes slowly evolved over time. The video then shows how early empires, Europe, and later the United States used tariffs to protect their economies. Moving to the present, we explain how Donald Trump turned tariffs into a weapon, using them aggressively to pressure countries into new trade deals. A major focus is India, where Trump pushed to open the agriculture and dairy sectors…
